name: Dokis & Dragons
source:
Prepare yourself to embark on an adventure in the liter— I mean, the DnD club! Here you can meet our wonderful adventurers, Sayori, Monika, Yuri, and Natsuki! Join them in their grand conquest of a fantastic world! Create your own character and take a chance at falling in love with these DnD girls! In your conquest, you will roll the dice, battle many foes, and take any opportunity to show-off your skills! Every single step of the way could be easily swayed by fate itself! Good luck, adventurer!
[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/dokis-n-dragons]DokiMods[/url]]
